asset_manifest.pose: dino_bones_paleontologist_6 (African female grad student, braided hair) is documenting a sequence of prints on a mottled red and white clay surface.

visual_notes.ichnology: Standard 'four-point' walking sequence. Alternating manus-pes pairs. The tracks are sharp and well-defined. Puncture cavities from the claws show high-contrast shadows against the red mottled clay.
visual_notes.ground: Mottled red and purple mudstone with patches of white sand and charcoal-grey plant debris.
